saw_lines: Nobody buys an indoor garden on impulse. They weigh one system’s price against store herbs, then reorder pods.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where price and a reason to buy now must appear.
Your site offers 30% off and free shipping over $150, yet 0 of 27 ads mention either. Put the 30% offer in the first line of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 30% off and free shipping over $150, yet 0 of 27 ads mention either, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act. Put the 30% offer in the first line of three new ads.
Your site shows prices from $14.95 to $299.95, yet 0 of 30 ads mention price, so buyers cannot judge cost before they click. Lead one ad with the price per pod and what fresh herbs cost at the store.
0 of 27 ads carry a proof number, so a buyer paying $209 for a system has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one real count, such as reviews or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

Seven ads have kept running for 60+ days, so they are your proven winners. Build three more variations of your longest-running winner, changing only the opening line and keeping the same scene and product.
